note: Data-driven model-tier map. The single owner is bin/fm-token-tier-lib.sh; this file is its data. A recorded model id is matched, case-insensitively, against each tier's glob patterns in array order; the first tier with any matching pattern wins, and a model that matches no tier falls into default_tier. So a NEW model lands in a sensible tier without a code edit, and an unrecognized model lands in the explicit default bucket rather than a fabricated tier. Patterns are shell-style globs (fnmatch): * matches any run, so wrap a substring in *...* to match anywhere. The fleet splits tooling work to the cheap deepseek flash lane and product work to opus, so those two tiers are the ones that matter; extend the patterns here (not the code) as the fleet's model mix changes.
